name: corrective-rag
title: Retrieval that grades and corrects itself

comparison.purpose: Retrieves documents about LLM agents, grades whether they actually answer the question, and falls back to a rewritten lookup in a separate sample index (a stand-in for web search) before answering.

starters.label: Corpus miss — corrected via the sample index

input.question: What is prompt injection and how do you defend against it?

starters.label: Near-miss doc — graded away, then corrected

input.question: What is a vector database and why does RAG need one?
How does long-term memory work for LLM agents?

starters.label: Off-corpus question (expect no evidence, even in the fallback index)

input.question: How much rainfall did the Amazon basin get last month?
